# Caramel Migration Contract

The migration is a translation of an approved static frontend.

It must preserve content, semantic structure, Tailwind classes, responsive behaviour, assets, accessibility attributes, metadata and approved visual hierarchy.

It must not add backend services, API routes, server actions, databases, authentication, CMS integration, payments, webhooks, analytics or new external services.

It must not modify the approved static source during the first pass. It must generate into the approved target directory and report unresolved forms, scripts, links, assets, image dimensions and dependencies.

It must stop on missing approval, dirty-state conflicts, unknown routes, missing assets, unapproved packages or ambiguous interactions.
